name: design-system
description: Code-first design system: run a zero-setup audit on any repo (design-audit), score its AI-native readiness (readiness-audit), sync a Claude Design system into design/tokens.css (claude-design-sync), audit code-only drift against design/guardrails.mdx (drift-report), and query the contract. The three audits run the deterministic `audit counters` script and score from a `rubric.json` published next to each skill. Figma sync is an OPTIONAL adapter (figma/tokens/sync-to-figma/check-parity).
author: systemix

mcp: The code-first core (design-audit, claude-design-sync, drift-report) needs no MCP
Figma MCP + Figma Console MCP — OPTIONAL, only for the Figma adapter (figma/tokens/sync-to-figma/check-parity)
tools: Node.js with npx, and bash (the audit skills run the counters CLI)
jq (the audit recipes; any JSON reader will do)

startWith: /design-audit  (zero-setup audit of any repo — the front door; then /drift-report to hold the line)
